question: Sangai festival is the biggest annual cultural festival organised by the Department of Tourism of Manipur every year. In which of the following months is it celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __November.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sangai festival** is the biggest annual cultural festival organised by the** Department of Tourism of Manipur every year.**
 
• It is celebrated in **November **month.
 
• It is celebrated every year from **21 to 30 November.**
 
• The old name of the Sangai festival is Tourism Festival.
 
• The festival has been renamed the Sangai festival from 2010 onwards.
 
• Since 2017, Sangai Festival events have been held at Mao Ukhrul, Keibul Lamjao, Khuman Lampak, Hapta Kangjeibung.
